sloka: रामाय तु यथा तत्त्वम् जटायो हरणम् मम ।लक्ष्मणाय च तत् सर्वम् आख्यातव्यम् अशेषतः ॥३-४९-४०॥
transliteration: rāmāya tu yathā tattvam jaṭāyo haraṇam mama ।lakṣmaṇāya ca tat sarvam ākhyātavyam aśeṣataḥ ॥3-49-40॥

translations.english: This nightranger is equipped with weapons. Cruel, strong and evilminded, he has won wars. You cannot stop him.
